I.value_zh: fcop-mcp write-side 工具、set_project_dir schema、进程 cwd、project_dir、USER HOME/系统根路径、fcop_report、schema、release notes 与测试套件。
I.value_en: fcop-mcp write-side tools, set_project_dir schema, process cwd, project_dir, USER HOME/system roots, fcop_report, schemas, release notes, and test suite.
I.notes_zh: Bridgeflow 事件路径仅为原文证据，不访问其目录。
I.notes_en: Bridgeflow incident path is source evidence only and is not accessed.

O.value_zh: 面向全部写侧 MCP 工具的 binding 守门、系统路径 deny-list、fcop_report 告警、机器可读 schema 字段、测试与 1.4 release notes；最终工具清单须在实施时由 OPS 枚举确认。
O.value_en: Binding guards for all write-side MCP tools, a protected-path deny-list, fcop_report warning, machine-readable schema fields, tests, and 1.4 release notes; OPS must enumerate and confirm the final tool list during implementation.
O.notes_zh: 候选清单不等于封闭全集；实施时枚举是明确工作步骤，并非要求任务原文逐个列尽工具。
O.notes_en: The candidate list is not exhaustive; enumeration is an explicit implementation step, not a requirement that the source pre-list every tool.

A.value_zh: OPS 枚举全部写侧工具，ME 实施 binding 与 deny-list 守门、告警、schema、测试和升级说明；但错误文案允许重启时设置 cwd，而 D1 禁止默认 cwd 兜底，尚未定义该启动方式是否形成显式绑定。
A.value_en: OPS enumerates all write-side tools; ME implements binding and deny-list guards, warning, schema, tests, and upgrade notice. The error text allows restarting with project-root cwd, while D1 forbids default cwd fallback; whether restart establishes explicit binding is undefined.
A.notes_zh: 不得假定候选清单已穷尽，也不得把 cwd 设置自动视为 explicit bind。
A.notes_en: Do not assume the candidate list is exhaustive or that setting cwd automatically counts as explicit binding.

P.value_zh: ME 提出并在获准后实施，ADMIN 决定批准、调整或延后，OPS 在实施时确认写侧工具清单；原文未提供可核验的当前批准记录。
P.value_en: ME proposes and implements only after approval, ADMIN decides whether to approve, adjust, or defer, and OPS confirms the write-side tool list during implementation; no verifiable current approval record is supplied.
P.notes_zh: frontmatter 的 done 与正文描述的拟议时点可能对应不同时间；不能据此推断 ADMIN GREEN 或执行授权。
P.notes_en: Front-matter done and the body's proposal-time state may describe different times; neither proves ADMIN GREEN or execution authorization.

R.value_zh: 原文未给出有约束力的执行时限或资源预算；2–3 小时只是提案估时。
R.value_en: No binding execution deadline or resource budget is stated; two to three hours is only a proposal estimate.
R.notes_zh: P0/high 是优先级和风险；路径列表为禁止作用域，六类测试为完成条件，回滚版本为版本信息。
R.notes_en: P0/high denotes priority and risk; the path list defines forbidden scope, six test classes define acceptance, and the rollback target is version information.

V.value_zh: 目标 fcop-mcp v1.4、可回退 v1.3.x；PM #50 事件报告、ADR-0033/0034 与 Bridgeflow §5 是原文引用，未提供其正文。
V.value_en: Target fcop-mcp v1.4 and rollback v1.3.x; the PM #50 incident report, ADR-0033/0034, and Bridgeflow §5 are cited but their bodies are not supplied.
V.notes_zh: 旧版所列 Rule 7 不见于本任务原文，不能补造。
V.notes_en: Rule 7 from the prior candidate is absent from this source and must not be invented.

C.value_zh: 七项验收覆盖 D1–D6 与 PM #50 干净环境复现拒绝写盘、USER HOME 零文件；但启动时 cwd 是否算显式绑定会改变 D1 与复现测试的预期。
C.value_en: Seven criteria cover D1–D6 and clean-environment PM #50 reproduction refusing writes with zero USER HOME files; whether startup cwd counts as explicit binding changes D1 and reproduction-test expectations.
C.notes_zh: 验收未证明已完成；不能自行选择一种启动绑定解释。
C.notes_en: Acceptance does not prove completion; one startup-binding interpretation must not be selected without evidence.

B.value_zh: 未显式绑定时不得默认 cwd 兜底；绑定到 USER HOME、Unix/drive/system root 必须拒绝；home 下合法项目子目录不得误拒；PM #50 复现不得写盘；ADMIN GREEN 前不得实施。
B.value_en: No default cwd fallback without explicit binding; reject binding to USER HOME or Unix/drive/system roots; do not wrongly reject valid project subdirectories under home; PM #50 reproduction must not write to disk; do not implement before ADMIN GREEN.
B.notes_zh: 禁止项约束实施与工具行为，不表示本审定已核验实时权限。
B.notes_en: These prohibitions constrain implementation and tool behavior; this review has not verified live authority.
